payload.content: Under InnoDB MVCC, what information does a Read View use to decide whether a row version is visible?
It checks transaction IDs, but I do not remember the exact boundaries. I think versions older than the current transaction are visible.
How does Read View creation differ between READ COMMITTED and REPEATABLE READ?
I think both create a new Read View for every SELECT, because each SELECT needs the latest committed version.
If transaction T1 under RR performs two consistent reads and T2 commits an update between them, should T1 normally see the new value on its second read? Explain.
Yes, since T2 committed before the second SELECT, I think the second read should see it.
That is enough evidence for this assessment. End it for independent evaluation.
